proof_availability.classification_scope: Uniform force ramp and retained constant stiffness are necessary to the stated energy estimate; duration or monotonicity alone is insufficient. Restricted local positivity is not full buckling/6D stability. Low trigger force is not low released energy, and slow exterior release does not remove retained internal energy. Catalogue ratings are not this assembly, waveform, life or cost. Fixed-ledger waivers are arithmetic contracts rather than constructed services.
